title: Morphogen-Guided Differentiation of Brain Cell Types from Human iPSCs
author: Qian, Rosa, et al.

steps.title: Coat plates with Matrigel
steps.instruction: Prepare growth‑factor‑reduced Matrigel coating for a 6‑well plate.

substeps.instruction: Pre‑rinse a pipette with ice‑cold DMEM.
Dilute 192 µL frozen Matrigel (8–11 mg/mL) in 48 mL ice‑cold DMEM; mix gently.
Add 2 mL of the diluted Matrigel to each well of a tissue‑culture‑treated 6‑well plate.
Incubate the plate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 1 hour.

steps.title: Prepare complete mTeSR Plus medium
steps.instruction: Make 1× mTeSR Plus complete medium and add antibiotics.

substeps.instruction: Thaw 100 mL mTeSR Plus supplement (5×).
Mix the supplement with 400 mL mTeSR Plus basal medium to obtain a final 1× concentration.
Add Antibiotic‑Antimycotic to a final 1× concentration.

steps.title: Make HPC basal medium
steps.instruction: Prepare the basal medium for hematopoietic progenitor cell (HPC) differentiation.

substeps.instruction: Combine equal volumes of IMDM (46.8 mL) and F12 (46.8 mL) for a total of 100 mL.
Add 10 µg/mL poly‑vinyl alcohol (PVA) – 100 µL.
Add 1 % (v/v) Antibiotic‑Antimycotic (100×) – 1 mL.
Add 1 % (v/v) GlutaMAX (100×) – 1 mL.
Add 1 % (v/v) MEM NEAA (100×) – 1 mL.
Add 1 % (v/v) CD lipid concentrate – 1 mL.
Add 64 µg/mL ascorbic acid – 178 µL.
Add 2 % (v/v) ITS‑X – 2 mL.
Add 20 µg/mL insulin – 200 µL.
Add 400 µM MTG – 100 µL.

steps.title: Prepare HPC Day 0‑2 medium
steps.instruction: Supplement HPC basal medium for days 0 to 2 of differentiation.

substeps.instruction: Add FGF2 to a final 50 ng/mL – 250 µL per 100 mL.
Add BMP4 to a final 50 ng/mL – 100 µL per 100 mL.
Add activin A to a final 12.5 ng/mL – 100 µL per 100 mL.
Add LiCl to a final 2 mM – 100 µL per 100 mL.
Add thiazovivin (Tzv) to a final 10 µM – 100 µL per 100 mL.

steps.title: Prepare HPC Day 2‑4 medium
steps.instruction: Supplement HPC basal medium for days 2 to 4 of differentiation.

substeps.instruction: Add FGF2 to a final 50 ng/mL – 250 µL per 100 mL.
Add VEGF to a final 50 ng/mL – 100 µL per 100 mL.

steps.title: Prepare HPC Day 4‑10 medium
steps.instruction: Supplement HPC basal medium for days 4 to 10 of differentiation.

substeps.instruction: Add FGF2 to a final 50 ng/mL – 250 µL per 100 mL.
Add VEGF to a final 50 ng/mL – 100 µL per 100 mL.
Add TPO to a final 50 ng/mL – 100 µL per 100 mL.
Add SCF to a final 10 ng/mL – 10 µL per 100 mL.
Add IL‑6 to a final 50 ng/mL – 650 µL per 100 mL.
Add IL‑3 to a final 10 ng/mL – 310 µL per 100 mL.

steps.title: Pre‑equilibrate HPC media under hypoxia
steps.instruction: Place all HPC differentiation media in a hypoxia incubator (5 % O₂, 5 % CO₂) for 1 hour at 37 °C before use.

steps.title: Prepare microglia basal medium
steps.instruction: Formulate the basal medium for microglia differentiation.

substeps.instruction: Add 92.4 mL phenol‑free DMEM/F12 to reach 100 mL total volume.
Add 1 % (v/v) Antibiotic‑Antimycotic (100×) – 1 mL.
Add 1 % (v/v) GlutaMAX (100×) – 1 mL.
Add 1 % (v/v) MEM NEAA (100×) – 1 mL.
Add 2 % (v/v) ITS‑G – 2 mL.
Add 2 % (v/v) B27 with Vitamin A – 2 mL.
Add 0.5 % (v/v) N2 supplement – 0.5 mL.
Add MTG to a final 200 µM – 50 µL.
Add insulin to a final 5 µg/mL – 50 µL.

steps.title: Prepare microglia Day 0‑25 (3 GF) medium
steps.instruction: Add the first set of cytokines to the microglia basal medium for days 0–25.

substeps.instruction: Add IL‑34 to a final 100 ng/mL – 100 µL per 100 mL.
Add M‑CSF to a final 25 ng/mL – 100 µL per 100 mL.
Add TGF‑β to a final 50 ng/mL – 100 µL per 100 mL.

steps.title: Prepare microglia Day 25‑28 (5 GF) medium
steps.instruction: Add the extended cytokine cocktail to the microglia basal medium for days 25–28.

substeps.instruction: Add IL‑34 to a final 100 ng/mL – 100 µL per 100 mL.
Add M‑CSF to a final 25 ng/mL – 100 µL per 100 mL.
Add TGF‑β to a final 50 ng/mL – 100 µL per 100 mL.
Add CX3CL1 to a final 100 ng/mL – 100 µL per 100 mL.
Add CD200 to a final 100 ng/mL – 100 µL per 100 mL.

steps.title: Prepare EB basal differentiation medium
steps.instruction: Create the basal medium for embryoid body (EB) differentiation.

substeps.instruction: Add 95.8 mL DMEM/F12 with GlutaMAX.
Add 1 % (v/v) Antibiotic‑Antimycotic (100×) – 1 mL.
Add 1 % (v/v) N2 supplement – 1 mL.
Add 2 % (v/v) B27 without Vitamin A – 2 mL.

steps.title: Add small‑molecule inhibitors to EB medium
steps.instruction: Supplement EB basal medium with pathway inhibitors.

substeps.instruction: Add LDN‑193189 to a final 0.1 µM – 100 µL per 100 mL.
Add SB‑431542 to a final 10 µM – 100 µL per 100 mL.

steps.title: Prepare NPC basal differentiation medium
steps.instruction: Formulate the basal medium for neural progenitor cell (NPC) differentiation.

substeps.instruction: Add 95.9 mL DMEM/F12 with GlutaMAX.
Add 1 % (v/v) Antibiotic‑Antimycotic (100×) – 1 mL.
Add 1 % (v/v) N2 supplement – 1 mL.
Add 2 % (v/v) B27 without Vitamin A – 2 mL.

steps.title: Add FGF2 to NPC medium
steps.instruction: Supplement NPC basal medium with fibroblast growth factor‑2.

substeps.instruction: Add FGF2 to a final 20 ng/mL – 100 µL per 100 mL.

description: This protocol outlines the differentiation of hematopoietic progenitor cells (HPCs), followed by microglia and neural progenitor cells (NPCs), followed by astrocytes and mixed cortical cultures from human induced pluripotent cells (hiPSC). We also describe approaches for cell identity validation via fluorescence-activated cell sorting (FACS), magnetic-activated cell sorting (MACS), and immunocytochemistry. Before initiating any differentiation, all hiPSCs must be quality-controlled for mycoplasma negative, karyotype normal, and pluripotency. Once the hiPSC lines are established and stored in cryopreserved stocks, this differentiation protocol can proceed. Reconstitution of small molecules and growth factors in aliquots and preparation of cell culture media are required before starting the protocol. It is recommended to plan out the timeline and usage of supplemented media across stages of differentiation to avoid expiration of reagents and growth factors. All the in-house generated hiPSC lines (TCW et al., 2022) and the commercially available KOLF2.1J hiPSC line have been authenticated for mycoplasma negative and normal karyotypes. All experiments are performed in a BSL2 safety cabinet.
